reference_sql:
WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per 2025 order of a registered customer
  SELECT customer_id, order_id, channel,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts DESC, order_id) AS rn
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY channel
alternatives:
SELECT o.channel, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM orders o
WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM orders o2
    WHERE o2.customer_id = o.customer_id
      AND o2.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND o2.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND (o2.order_ts > o.order_ts OR (o2.order_ts = o.order_ts AND o2.order_id < o.order_id))
  )
GROUP BY o.channel

SELECT t.channel, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM (
  -- one row per 2025 order of a registered customer
  SELECT customer_id, order_id, channel,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts DESC, order_id) AS rn
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
) AS t
WHERE t.rn = 1
GROUP BY t.channel

solver.query:
WITH last_o AS (
  SELECT customer_id, channel,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts DESC, order_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS customers
  FROM last_o
  WHERE rn = 1
  GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT ch.channel, COALESCE(cnt.customers, 0) AS customers
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT channel FROM orders) ch
LEFT JOIN cnt ON cnt.channel = ch.channel
